Text Shadow Generator

Design CSS text-shadows with sliders — offsets, blur, color and opacity — with a live preview and copyable code.

Shadow Text

📖 How to use

  1. Type your sample text (or keep the default).
  2. Drag the offset, blur and opacity sliders and pick a shadow color.
  3. Copy the generated text-shadow CSS.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What CSS is generated?

A standard text-shadow declaration, e.g. text-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); — with your exact values.

How is opacity applied?

The picked color is converted to rgba() with your opacity value, so the shadow blends realistically over backgrounds.

Can I preview on a dark background?

Yes — toggle the dark preview to check how the shadow reads on both light and dark surfaces.
